system.description:
Claw Unarmed Strikes roll Strange instead of the usual skill and deal 3 Pierce. To hide the claws while attacking, pass a CR 1 Wit Check or fight in a way that hides them. Doom +1 per successful claw Strike.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.63
system.summary: Claw Unarmed Strikes roll Strange instead of the usual skill and deal 3 Pierce. To hide the claws while attacking, pass a CR 1 Wit Check or fight in a way that hides them. Doom +1 per successful claw Strike.

automation.note: Use this ability for your Unarmed Strikes (Strange, 3 Pierce, Close) instead of the normal Unarmed Strike. Instead of the Wit Check you can describe fighting in a way that hides the claws.
